took its region (allocate before free: the liveness re-check)". It is the note's P3: on the 3 × 3 grid with the
north-east slot freed and committed, it fills the kept map, allocates the north region's new record (slot 8), frees
slot 7, asserts the key unchanged, and asserts the answer names the new slot, not 7, with the same rings and one

(the inventory's first alternative), plus a test; M0-a-06's confirmation REPORTED. CONFIRMED (executed and read).**
C-0361 (2) states C-0163 (1)'s premise: the live face records of a level own disjoint rings (§2.2 rule 1, the
`LevelFaces` table). It says the one transient that breaks it (inside a batch, between an allocation and the free of

(… §2.2 rule 1 broken), answers without a throw, each neighbour a live record on that ring (C-0163 (1)'s premise,

transaction can query between an allocation and its free is M0-a-06's transaction design, outside this item's owns,
